headline: Approved applying for and accepting a little over $54,000 Edward Byrne grant to buy a police cruiser.
summary: Chief Carter and Captain Diaz gave updates on staffing and overtime. Members unanimously approved applying for and accepting grant funds to buy a new police cruiser.
decisions: Approved applying for and accepting a little over $54,000 from the 2025 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant to buy a new police cruiser, passed unanimously with 0 opposed and 0 abstentions.

decision_titles: 2025 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Committee Members: 
Present - Sean Cardwell 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Tom Figlar 
Absent - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Public Safety Committee, September 14, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was called to 
order at 8:53pm with the members noted above in attendance.   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to give public input. Public Input was closed at 8:55pm. 
   
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming Boards/Commission meetings was shared.  Chief Carter and 
Captain Diaz both provided updates on staffing and their department’s overtime to date.   
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. ORDER AUTHORIZING THE TOWN OF HAMDEN TO APPLY AND IF AWARDED 
ACCEPT AND EXPEND FUNDS FROM THE 2025 EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL 
JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT FROM THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE 
Motion to open Item 4.1 was made by Council member Figlar; seconded by Chair 
Webber.   
Cap’t Diaz provided an overview noting that the grant was for a little over $54,000 
and would be used to purchase a new police cruiser.  
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 4.1 passed unanimously. 
    
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7
. 
ADJOURN – 9:10pm 
With no additional business before the committee, Vice Chair Hunt adjourned at 9:10pm.
